issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. The diff adds no file or network access, pastes no coordinates and uses no outside answers. All randomness still comes from the seeded rng.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. The change turns the local-kick search into threshold acceptance: kicks now start from `cur`, which is accepted if it is within tau of the best sum, with tau falling linearly from 0.01 to 0. `best` is still updated only on strict improvement and is what gets returned. Every candidate still passes through clip and _repair, so the returned packing stays valid. Timing is unchanged: the loop is still bounded by TIME_FRACTION * time_limit.

Small point: `cur` never jumps back to `best`. Because tau is measured against best's sum and reaches 0 at the end of the time budget, the search effectively drifts back towards solutions near best, so this is acceptable.

The numbers support the decision. The candidate's loss of -2.6334 is worse than the incumbent's mean of -2.6349 by 0.0015. With sd 0.0023 and 1 vs 2 runs, the standard error is 0.0023*sqrt(1+1/2) ≈ 0.00282, so z ≈ -0.53, where negative means worse. The harness's -0.514 matches up to rounding of the displayed means. Reject is consistent, though n=1 makes this weak evidence either way.
